Terms & Conditions

Delivery Partner Terms & Conditions

1. Accurate Information
All personal, vehicle, address, PIN code and contact information must be accurate and current.

2. Haldwani Service Area
Delivery service is currently available in Haldwani only.

3. Email Verification
A valid email address must be verified before Delivery Panel access.

4. Account Security
Keep your account credentials private and do not share your account.

5. Order & Delivery Responsibility
Accept and deliver orders responsibly and update order status honestly.

6. Admin Approval
Creating an account does not automatically activate the Delivery Panel. Admin approval is required.

7. Acceptance
By selecting I Agree, you confirm that you have read and accepted these terms.
